离线 · 无上传 · 浏览器本地完成Offline · no uploads · runs in the browser

JSON 转 JPG——离线、A4 分页逐页编码、不上传JSON to JPG offline — A4 pages, no upload

这条路的形状与 PNG 那一格不同，而且差别是**路由里写明的**：`json>html` 之后，同为图片目标的 JPEG 先走 `html>pdf` 再走 `pdf>jpg`，而不是「截一张长图再压缩」。理由写在 `html-to-pdf.ts` 的注释里——`html→png→jpg` 交回的是按页面宽度排布的一条长带，而一份要分享或打印的 JSON 快照通常需要页边界；所以这条链在终点相同的比较里显式让 `html>pdf` 优先（`edgePreference`）。产物有三个具体后果：**一页一图**，长文件出多张并以 ZIP 交付；**中间那份 PDF 的页面是无损位图**（逐页 PNG 数据 URL 再嵌进文档），有损只发生在最后那一次 JPEG 编码；**折行仍由页面宽度决定**，长字符串在页内断开，断开的样子进图。可调的是质量与最长边，编码前按 `clampQuality` / `clampMaxEdge` 再钳一次，因为它们也可能来自存储而不是这次点选。与 PNG 那一格共享的边界也还在：整页渲染高度上限 32768 px、查看器不含远程引用、图片里没有可复制的文字。全过程在这个标签页里完成，只有 storage 权限。This route has a different shape from the PNG page, and the difference is **stated in the routing**: after `json>html`, a JPEG target goes through `html>pdf` and then `pdf>jpg` rather than “capture one tall image and compress it”. The reason is in the comment at `html-to-pdf.ts` — `html→png→jpg` hands back a single strip laid out at page width, while a JSON snapshot meant for sharing or printing usually wants page boundaries, so the tie between the two image ends is broken explicitly in favour of `html>pdf` (`edgePreference`). Three concrete consequences: **one image per page**, so a long file yields several pictures delivered in a ZIP; **the PDF in the middle carries lossless bitmaps** (each page is PNG data URL before it is embedded), so the only lossy step is the final JPEG encode; and **layout still decides wrapping**, since long strings break inside the page and that broken-up look is what gets imaged. Quality and the longest edge are adjustable and re-clamped before encoding by `clampQuality` / `clampMaxEdge`, because those values can also arrive from storage rather than from this click. The boundaries shared with the PNG page remain: a 32768 px ceiling on rendered page height, a viewer with no remote reference, and no copyable text inside an image. All of it inside this tab on the storage permission.

这条链路怎么走How the route runs

JSONJSON →HTMLHTML →PDFPDF →JPEGJPEG

共 3 步，由扩展的路径搜索自动选出，中间产物不落盘。3 steps, chosen by the extension's own path search; intermediate results never touch the disk.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 按 A4 分页、一页一 JPEG：每张都是完整的一页，而不是一条被切开的长带A4 pages, one JPEG each: every picture is a whole page rather than a slice of one long strip
  • 只有一次有损：中间那份 PDF 的页面是无损 PNG，压缩只发生在最后交给 JPEG 的那一次Only one lossy step: the PDF in the middle holds lossless PNG pages, so compression happens once, on the way out
  • 语法着色与折叠摘要按渲染结果进图，看起来就是你在浏览器里看到的那份查看器Syntax colouring and fold summaries enter the image as rendered, so it looks like the viewer you saw in the browser
  • 质量与最长边可调，并在编码前按同一套边界再钳一次（存储里的值也钳）Quality and the longest edge are adjustable and re-clamped against the same bounds before encoding, including values coming from storage

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 多页会打包成 ZIP：一份长 JSON 可能出十几张编号图片，只想要一张长图请走 JSON→PNGSeveral pages arrive as a ZIP: a long JSON can produce a dozen numbered pictures, so take JSON to PNG when you want one tall image
  • 一次最多渲染 200 页（`MAX_PDF_IMAGE_PAGES`）：超过就报「要渲染的页数过多」，并让你用页码范围只选需要的页或先把文件拆开——每一页在编码前各自占着一张全尺寸画布，200 页已经是数百 MB，再往前是标签页自己崩掉，那比一条错误难说清得多At most 200 pages rasterise in one pass (`MAX_PDF_IMAGE_PAGES`): past that the route reports “too many pages to render at once” and points at a page range or splitting the file — every page holds a full-size canvas until it is encoded, 200 of them is already hundreds of megabytes, and beyond that the tab crashes itself, which is far harder to explain than an error
  • JPEG 是有损的：等宽字形的细边与语法着色的小面积色块会留下压缩痕迹，低对比的那类最敏感JPEG is lossy: thin monospace edges and the small colour fields of syntax highlighting show artefacts, and low-contrast pairs suffer most
  • 文字进图就不可选：产物没有文字层，不能搜索也不能复制；要这些请走 JSON→TXT / HTML / MarkdownText inside an image is not selectable: there is no text layer to search or copy; take JSON to TXT, HTML or Markdown for that
  • 整页渲染高度上限 32768 px 仍然适用，超限报错而不是交付被截短的内容The 32768 px ceiling on rendered page height still applies, and exceeding it reports failure instead of delivering trimmed content
  • 不承诺能再解析回 JSON：这一格交付的是给人看的快照，不是数据交换格式No promise that it parses back to JSON: this page delivers a snapshot for people to read, not a data format

实操提示Working with it

  • 想要一张不分页的长图：JSON→PNG，同一条渲染链的另一半For one unpaginated tall image: JSON to PNG, the other half of the same rendering chain
  • 想要成品文档：JSON→PDF，页面就是文档本身、还能继续打印For a finished document: JSON to PDF, whose pages are the artifact and still print
  • 想要小体积又可读：先看 JSON→HTML 的渲染，再决定是截长图还是分页For the smallest readable result: look at JSON to HTML first, then decide between a tall shot and pages

常见问题Questions people actually ask

为什么不干脆把长图压成 JPEG，而要分页？Why page it instead of just compressing the tall image?

因为那条路交回的是按页面宽度排布的一条长带，而这条取舍写在路由里：同分的图片终点由 `edgePreference` 排序（`html>pdf` 是 0、`html>png` 是 10，小的排前面），不是实现顺带的后果。分页给的是页边界与一页一图，长图给的是单次捕获。Because that route hands back a single strip laid out at page width, and the choice is written into the routing: the tie between the two image ends is ordered by `edgePreference` (0 on `html>pdf`, 10 on `html>png`, lower first), not an accident of implementation. Paging buys page bounds and one picture per page; the tall capture buys a single canvas.

一次有损和两次有损，差别在哪里？One lossy step or two — where is the difference?

中间那份 PDF 的页面是无损 PNG，所以文字与色块在渲染之后只被 JPEG 编过一次。若中间先出 JPEG 再出 JPEG，细字与着色边界会被压两次——这条链刻意避开那种形状。The PDF in the middle holds lossless PNG pages, so your glyphs and colour fields are JPEG-encoded exactly once after rendering. Going JPEG to JPEG would crush thin strokes and highlight edges twice, which is the shape this chain avoids.

长文件会得到几个文件？How many files does a long document produce?

一页一张，张数由排版后的总高度除以页高决定；两张以上时产物是一个 ZIP。想要单份文件，请走 JSON→PNG（一张长图）或 JSON→PDF（一份文档）。One picture per page, the count set by the laid-out height divided by page height, and two or more arrive inside a ZIP. For a single file take JSON to PNG (one tall image) or JSON to PDF (one document).

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
